results.title: B.A.E. - Before Anything Else
results.overview: On the threshold of adulthood, Romeo spends a final summer in Tropea with his friends, where he meets Giulia, a local theater enthusiast. As their romance blossoms, the two end up starring in a local production of Romeo and Juliet, and their real lives begin to painfully parallel the classic play. Facing opposition from Giulia’s overprotective brother and the pressure of an uncertain future, their bond deepens until a tragic confrontation alters their lives forever. B.A.E. - Before Anything Else is a poignant exploration of first love, passion, and devastating sacrifice.

results.title: God I Want You
results.overview: After his ex-girlfriend gets engaged, a man struggles to see God’s plan for his life. He looks for answers in another lost soul.

results.title: Peter
results.overview: Set against the misty green landscapes of Madikeri and Bhagamandala, Peter is a gripping suspense drama that delves into secrets, crimes, and human emotions that refuse to stay buried. It's an edge-of-your-seat suspense drama that unravels mystery, emotions, and shocking truths in the heart of Coorg's haunting beauty. Peter takes you on an unforgettable, suspenseful journey where love, crime, and betrayal collide.

results.overview: A grieving Persian-Kurdish mother and her American daughter head to the scenic Azores on conflicting agendas, but their clash of perspectives turns into a path toward healing under the influence of a handsome local guide.

results.title: Grandes maricas y bolleras de la historia
results.original_title: Grandes maricas y bolleras de la historia
results.overview: Rodrigo Cuevas serves as a guide in this museum of history's great gay and lesbian figures. Over the course of 90 minutes, the program approaches 16 historical figures from a queer perspective. Guests such as Bob Pop, Laura del Val, Valeria Vegas, Ángel Ruiz, María Peláe, and Ramón Martínez contribute their knowledge and viewpoints to highlight the sexual diversity—which history has hidden—of figures as diverse as Queen Christina of Sweden, Marlene Dietrich, Miguel de Molina, Chavela Vargas, Hans Christian Andersen, Jacinto Benavente, Leonardo Da Vinci, and Lili Elbe. Irony, humor, and an accessible, modern language are the defining features of an educational and original historical narrative. It is based on solid documentation and uses AI-generated images to recreate passages from the lives of these historical figures.

results.title: Trophy
results.overview: When Max is caught by his father in a private moment, it has unexpected consequences for the family outing that follows. On the last summer day by the river, the fourteen-year-old is forced to rethink his understanding of masculinity.

results.title: Moi, Abou T, migrant, PD, menacé de mort
results.original_title: Moi, Abou T, migrant, PD, menacé de mort
results.overview: In 2029, Europe is under the rule of far-right regimes. In France, the National Party has just come to power. Homosexuality is criminalized across Europe, except in France. Abou, a gay migrant, arrives in Marseille to seek asylum. Left homeless, he endures the violence of life on the streets. When he finally manages to contact the only association authorized by the regime to assist migrants, he is confronted with a brutal reality.

results.title: Hot Water
results.overview: A Lebanese-American teenager gets expelled from school and is forced to drive cross-country with his neurotic mother. What begins as punishment becomes the longest, funniest, and most unexpectedly meaningful trip of his life.
